name: Netherborne raises Netherstrike's critical damage by 25 percent (#3213)
contract: Netherborne 801539 (Spell.dbc, passive, family 31) is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) on SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (misc 15), EffectBasePoints 24 + DieSides(1)-derived +1 = +25, class mask dword A bit18 (262144), exactly the SpellFamilyFlags of Netherstrike (806222, family 31). Netherstrike's own DmgClass is SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE (2), so in Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp ~9926) the melee branch sets crit_bonus = damage + damage = 2000 on a base of 1000, then the function isolates the bonus-only portion (crit_bonus -= damage -> 1000), runs it through Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS) -- the exact native call site Netherborne's aura feeds -- which adds 25% of that 1000 (=250), then adds damage back: 1000*1.25 + 1000 = 2250. So a talented cast must read 250 higher than the untalented 2000 baseline on a fixed base of 1000. No CoA script or dummy handler exists for 801539 anywhere in modules/mod-ascension-compat or src/server/game/Spells. spell_critical_damage (Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus with no hit roll or mitigation) reads this directly. A control target unaffected by the mask (Explode-style unrelated family-31 spell) is out of scope here; the negative control instead confirms the delta appears only after learning the talent. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively; no code change.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Netherstrike's untalented crit damage is the melee baseline (1000 direct + 1000 bonus = 2000)
Netherborne adds 25 percent of the melee crit bonus: 2000 -> 2250 on a base of 1000 (#3213)
